name: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift
description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a staggered stance that loads the hamstrings and glutes while shifting weight to the front leg.
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.
